meta.name: imagemagick-conversion
meta.description:
Convert and manipulate images with ImageMagick. Covers format conversion,
resizing, batch processing, quality adjustment, and image transformations.
Use when user mentions image conversion, resizing images, ImageMagick,
magick command, batch image processing, or thumbnail generation.

copy.tagline: 批量转换和调整图片格式与尺寸
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用命令行批量处理图片格式或尺寸。
copy.tagline_en: Batch convert and resize images with ImageMagick
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch process image formats or sizes via command line.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你使用 ImageMagick 的 magick 命令来转换图片格式、调整尺寸、批量处理、设置质量、生成缩略图以及进行旋转、裁剪等基本变换。
howto.when: 当你提到图片转换、调整尺寸、ImageMagick、magick 命令、批量图片处理或生成缩略图时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这张图片从 JPEG 转换成 PNG。
say.note: Claude 会给出对应的 magick 命令。

say.text: 把这个文件夹里所有图片缩小到 50%。
say.note: Claude 会提供批量调整尺寸的命令。

say.text: 生成一张 200x200 的缩略图。
say.note: Claude 会给出 thumbnail 命令。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you in using ImageMagick's magick command to convert image formats, resize, batch process, adjust quality, generate thumbnails, and perform basic transformations like rotate, crop, and flip.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention image conversion, resizing, ImageMagick, magick command, batch image processing, or thumbnail generation.

say_en.text: Convert this image from JPEG to PNG.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the corresponding magick command.

say_en.text: Resize all images in this folder to 50%.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a batch resize command.
Claude will give the thumbnail command.
